subject: Mythology
title: Nyaminyami: The Zambezi River God
description: One-minute skill: Nyaminyami: The Zambezi River God.

hook.text: When builders dammed the Zambezi River in the 1950s, the Tonga people warned that Nyaminyami would fight back.

buildup.text: Nyaminyami is a serpent god with a fish head who lives in the Zambezi and controls its floods and fish.

discovery.text: During dam construction, unprecedented floods destroyed the work site twice. Workers died in mysterious collapses.

twist.text: The Tonga believe Nyaminyami was separated from his wife by the dam and floods were his rage at the separation.

climax.text: The dam was built, but the Tonga say Nyaminyami still waits. One day, he will destroy it and reunite with his wife.

punchline.text: A modern dam was built against a god's wishes, and the god has not forgotten.

quiz.question: Why do the Tonga believe Nyaminyami caused floods during dam construction?
options: The dam was built on his sacred burial ground
The dam separated him from his wife and he raged against it
Humans forgot to make the proper offerings before building
